question: Behind a sign-up: after the Hurricane Electric registration form (tunnelbroker.net/register.php or ipv6.he.net/certification/register.php) is submitted, does a code go to the phone number, and is the account usable before it is entered? Does the server reject some e-mail domains (a forum user reports outlook.com addresses are refused, and the form posts the e-mail field to the server for a check as it is filled)?
why: identity_cost.kind is email unless a code to the phone is required, in which case it is any-phone. The form has a required phone text field that is posted to the server for a check as it is filled, a captcha field and no field for a code, and says an e-mail is sent to complete activating the account, so a code step could only appear after submission, which needs an account (AGENTS.md section 2 rule 13: an operator step).
